goal: Deliver a fast, truthful place-location preview backed by automatically maintained static map snapshots and open the existing interactive map only on demand.

intent_model.literal_request: For every place, capture and save a map image, show a floating open-map control, store whether the image exists, and automatically check missing images weekly in code.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Place pages feel instant and clean while map coverage heals automatically without chat reminders or repeated live tile loading.
likely_rejections: A business photograph is still labeled as a map
The solution works only for one world
A provider outage produces a blank image
The weekly check exists only as a claim and not executable code
Attribution is missing or the implementation scrapes public OSM tiles

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: All eligible public place records with approved coordinates across the shared affected family, not only the example place.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Require a complete inventory and coverage report, with explicit reasons for records lacking coordinates.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Persisted state, idempotent generation, a real scheduler entry point and recovery behavior in the product code.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A reminder or manual screenshot process cannot pass.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: A clear map image with one floating open-map action.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Open the live map only when the visitor wants to pan or zoom.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Activate the preview to load and use the interactive map.

natural_destination: Public VII place detail location sections and the unattended weekly runtime path.

facts.claim: The shared map currently uses a business image as its inactive preview and loads Leaflet after activation.
The runtime already has D1, R2 and a Worker scheduled entry point.
OSMF prohibits headless automated tile panning or prefetching from tile.openstreetmap.org.

assumptions.claim: A production-approved static-images provider credential can be supplied through managed environment secrets before publication.
assumptions.validation: Verify the selected provider and secret binding in the exact public candidate without exposing the credential.

in_scope: Persist snapshot status and immutable object identity
Generate only missing or stale eligible place snapshots
Run a guarded weekly reconciliation from code
Preserve the last ready snapshot on refresh failure
Serve snapshots with durable browser caching
Use the shared snapshot preview and lazy interactive map across callers
Keep visible map attribution and location precision semantics
Test success, missing, failure, duplicate, reload and responsive states
out_of_scope: Publishing the current bug batch before Adir says it is complete
Purchasing a map vendor plan or creating credentials
Replacing the interactive-map provider across search maps
Revealing more precise coordinates than the currently approved public record
invariants: Existing interactive zoom, pan, layer and marker behavior remains available after activation
Exact versus area-only precision remains unchanged
A failed refresh cannot delete or replace the last good snapshot
No provider token is exposed to the browser or committed to source
Other dirty bug-batch changes remain untouched
affected_family: vacation, event, spa, hourly and attraction detail pages

requirements.statement: The inactive map state displays a genuine saved map snapshot when ready and never mislabels a business photo as a map.
The live interactive map and its dependencies load only after activation.
Snapshot metadata records missing, processing, ready, failed and stale outcomes with source identity and timestamps.
A weekly idempotent reconciler fills missing or changed eligible snapshots and skips unchanged ready records.
Generation failure preserves the last good image and records actionable failure state without retry loops.
Map generation uses an approved static-images provider and retains required attribution; it does not scrape public OSM tiles.

acceptance_checks.setup: A place has a ready stored snapshot.
acceptance_checks.action: Open the detail page, then activate the map.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The stored image appears immediately; only activation replaces it with the working live map.

acceptance_checks.setup: A place has coordinates but no stored snapshot.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The UI uses an honest non-map fallback without a broken image, and persisted state remains missing until generation succeeds.

acceptance_checks.setup: A weekly run generates a valid image.
acceptance_checks.action: Read metadata and object storage again after the run.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Ready metadata, immutable key, content type, dimensions/source hash and object remain consistent.

acceptance_checks.setup: The same weekly window is invoked twice.
acceptance_checks.action: Run reconciliation twice with unchanged coordinates.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The second invocation skips the ready current record and creates no duplicate generation.

acceptance_checks.setup: A prior ready image exists and the provider times out or returns an invalid image.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The prior object stays active, failure metadata is recorded and no immediate unbounded retry occurs.

acceptance_checks.setup: No approved provider credential is configured.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The run records provider_not_configured, makes no OSM tile requests and does not change the active image.

acceptance_checks.setup: Desktop and 390px pages in representative worlds have ready snapshots.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload, focus and activate the preview.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The map image, attribution and action are unclipped and the live map remains usable.

open_questions.question: Which paid or owner-controlled static-images provider will be bound in production?
open_questions.resolution: Implement a provider adapter and fail-closed configuration now; choose and bind the credential before public release evidence.

authorization_boundary: Candidate implementation and non-production verification are authorized. Publication, vendor purchase and production secret mutation remain excluded until separately authorized.
